entries.title: Story Pages Load Faster
items: The "related stories" list at the bottom of each article now appears about 15 times faster
A change we made last week to speed up the homepage accidentally slowed this one part down — it's fixed
No change to what you see, just how quickly it gets there

entries.title: Category and Tag Pages Fixed
items: Category pages like Crime and Politics were quietly showing an old, frozen list of stories — they now show everything, currently 3,803 stories under Crime alone
Browsing by tag works again
Fixed our sitemap so search engines can find every story on the site

entries.title: Faster Page Loads
items: Article lists, the homepage and category pages now load close to instantly
Fixed the cause: the site was reading every one of its 37,000+ stories just to show you the newest 20
Our RSS feed and sitemap got the same fix, so news readers and search engines see updates faster too

entries.title: We're Back — Full Restoration Underway
items: Fixed a months-long issue that stopped new AI summaries from being generated behind the scenes
Reprocessing tens of thousands of backlogged articles now — thousands of new stories are appearing as we catch up
Sorry for the quiet stretch — we're back, and 915 TLDR is far from abandoned

entries.title: Contact Form Fix
items: Fixed an issue where messages sent through the contact form weren't reaching us

entries.title: Building in Public Changelog
items: New changelog page shows all site updates and improvements
Automated update system tracks changes as they happen
Transparent development - see what's new, what broke, and what's next

entries.title: Read Tracking with localStorage
items: Articles you've read now show with reduced opacity and an orange checkmark badge
New "Show unread only" toggle on the /new page to filter articles
Read count displayed showing progress through daily articles
Clear reading history button added to site footer
Reading progress persists across browser sessions

entries.title: Navigation Redesign & Mobile UX
items: Redesigned navigation with sticky header and category tabs
Mobile-optimized hamburger menu with full-screen overlay
Added "New" tab showing latest articles across all categories
Improved footer with quick links and social media
Editorial pages updated with new design language

entries.title: Admin Automation & About Page Redesign
items: Admin dashboard now shows real-time fetch status and automation health
About page redesigned with clearer mission statement
Source management improved with one-click enable/disable
Added statistics dashboard showing article coverage by category
